title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Application Services Manager
description:
POSITION: APPLICATION SERVICE MANAGER

LOCATION: CAMPINAS, SAO PAULO, BRAZIL.

WORKING MODEL: HYBRID (YOU WILL HAVE TO BE THERE AT CLIENT LOCATION FOR

2 DAYS IN A WEEK)


Purpose of the Role:

The Application Service Manager ensures end-to-end stability, performance, and governance of

applications within the Global Applications Management ecosystem.

This role combines technical oversight, vendor management, and financial control, ensuring

applications deliver continuous value, meet SLAs, and operate efficiently across multiple business

zones.

The Service Manager acts as the main point of accountability for operational excellence, cost

optimization, and service continuity of assigned applications.

Additionally, the ASM must engage with Function Tower teams from the early stages of any initiative

to ensure that applications are fully compliant with company standards, security guidelines, and

operational frameworks before go-live.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Application Portfolio Ownership

- Manage the full lifecycle of enterprise applications — deployment, monitoring, incident

response, maintenance, and decommissioning.

- Define and track KPIs and SLAs to ensure business continuity and customer satisfaction.

- Guarantee alignment with global IT policies, security standards, and audit requirements.

- Ensure all applications adhere to corporate cybersecurity policies, data protection

standards, and regulatory compliance requirements. Partner with Security and Compliance

teams to proactively mitigate risks and maintain audit readiness.

2. Service Delivery & Governance

- Oversee daily operations of ASM providers and internal teams, ensuring timely resolution of

incidents and service requests.

- Maintain dashboards and documentation to support transparency and performance

tracking.

- Partner with Function Towers from the design and early build phases to embed operational

readiness and compliance in every deployment.

- Good understanding of DevOps practices and automation to increase deployment

reliability, monitoring, and continuous improvement across environments.

- Ensure continuous monitoring and observability of applications and infrastructure,

leveraging dashboards, alerts, and trend analysis to proactively identify issues and

performance bottlenecks.

3. Vendor & Contract Management

- Act as primary interface with external vendors and service providers.

- Monitor contractual KPIs and escalate deviations as needed.

- Lead contract renewals, closing letters and negotiate improvements in service levels or

pricing structures.

4. Financial & OPEX Management

- Own the OPEX plan for assigned applications — budget, cost tracking, performance and

forecast.

- Identify optimization opportunities (e.G., license rationalization, cloud consumption, and

automation).

- Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure cost efficiency and alignment with global

financial targets.

5. Change & Release Management

- Oversee controlled deployment of application releases, patches, and upgrades.

- Ensure adherence to change management processes and communication with

stakeholders.

- Validate post-release performance and stability.

6. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

- Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Leads, and Regional IT teams to align priorities

and address operational pain points.

- Act as the voice of IT Operations in global projects, ensuring maintainability and scalability

considerations are embedded early.

- Facilitate cross-zone collaboration to promote process consistency and best practices.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related fields.

- Certifications such as ITIL, PMP, or equivalent are a plus.

Experience

- IT Operations or Application Management within large, complex environments.

- Proven experience managing enterprise applications and vendors contracts.

- Solid track record in cost management, governance, and service improvement initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of ITIL framework and service management principles.

- Proficiency in performance monitoring and troubleshooting tools.

- Analytical mindset with ability to interpret operational data and identify improvement levers.

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work across cultures and time zones.

- Advanced English proficiency.

Technical Knowledge

- Familiarity with enterprise technologies (e.G., Microsoft ecosystem, Azure, SAP, Power

Platform, Dataverse).

- Understanding databases, integrations, and cloud architecture.

- Experience with ticketing systems (e.G., ServiceNow) and monitoring tools (Datadog,

Grafana, etc)

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we're looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients' staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant's job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners' lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Especialista em Performance Web Front-End
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.

Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)

• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes ( Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.

- LCP

- CLS

- DASHBOARDS DE PERFORMANCE

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we're the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.

Role Overview

We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America, partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates' time zone

Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We're building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Especialista Em Ia E Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento emSQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Lead Accountant (Brazil) - Sqm Iodine & Plant Nutrition
description:
SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.


Every day we are inspired by our purpose: “we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress” , achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.


This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.


YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


Bank Management

  • Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
  • Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations.


Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
  • Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.


Credit and Commercial Control

  • Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.
  • Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.
  • Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.
  • Control and monitor customer credit lines.


Inventory Management

  • Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.
  • Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).
  • Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).


Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

  • Control recorded fixed assets.
  • Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
  • Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.


Payroll Management

  • Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
  • Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
  • Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.


General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.


Other Routine Activities

  • Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
  • Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.


THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

  • Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC)
  • Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
  • Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
  • Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Desirable use of Odoo
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
  • Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
  • Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council);
    IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.


WE OFFER:

  • Permanent hiring
  • Working day: Monday to Friday
  • Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil
  • The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning


At SQM Plant Nutrition, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. If you require any adjustments to participate in our selection processes, please let us know.

title: Desenvolvedor De Back End Node.Js
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.Js- Sênior.

Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.Js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.



Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.Js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.Js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.



Habilidades:


  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.Js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.Js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.Io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.Js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).

  • Treinamentos constantes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (Maternity Cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.


Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:


Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.


Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.


Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.G., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.


Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.


Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.


Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS:


  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:


Talent Development & Retention

  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
  • Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
  • Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
  • Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.G., workshops, speakers, EdCamps).


Attracting & Retaining Talent

  • Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:

Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.

  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.G., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.G., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.G., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Customer Support Manager Latam
description:
The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming our world—making it safer, more sustainable, and smarter. As a Quectel company, Acceleronix empowers customers to succeed in their IoT projects by turning innovative ideas into impactful, real-world solutions.


At Acceleronix, our customers' and employees' groundbreaking ideas drive everything we do. We take creative concepts from the drawing board to full production, delivering solutions that make a tangible difference.


Joining our team means collaborating with company leaders, and building strong relationships with colleagues who share your curiosity about connecting the unconnected. We're a team that cares deeply about our customers, values having fun, and is committed to making a positive impact in our local communities.


Role Overview


We’re seeking a proactive and experienced LATAM Customer Support Manager to build, lead, and scale our customer support function across Latin America. This role is based in Brazil Campinas and will be responsible for setting up the regional support team, defining workflows, and ensuring high service levels across technical support, commercial inquiries, and logistics coordination.


This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate strategically while actively engaging with customers and internal teams to solve challenges, improve operations, and ensure an exceptional customer experience.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Support Operations Build the LATAM Customer Support organization from the ground up, including hiring, onboarding, and mentoring support agents. Define and implement support workflows, escalation paths, and SLAs tailored to regional needs. Oversee support for technical issues, commercial inquiries, order tracking, and logistics coordination.


Knowledge Management Develop and maintain a robust knowledge base and internal documentation. Establish best practices for capturing, updating, and sharing critical customer-facing information.


Customer Engagement & Escalation Management Serve as the escalation point for key customers and complex support cases. Foster long-term customer relationships through effective communication and issue resolution.


Collaboration & Enablement Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Product teams to streamline support handoffs and improve customer journeys. Act as the voice of the customer to influence service improvements and product enhancements.


Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track KPIs and generate insights to drive process improvements. Establish reporting cadences for internal stakeholders and continuously evaluate performance metrics.


Qualifications


Experience 5+ years in a customer support or operations leadership role, ideally in an IoT environment, telco or B2B SAAS environments. Proven experience scaling support teams and building processes from scratch. Strong understanding of technical support, customer operations, and logistics in LATAM markets.


Skills


Exceptional problem-solving and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through. Comfortable with CRM and ticketing platforms (e.G., Freshdesk, Salesforce).


Mindset: Hands-on, entrepreneurial attitude with a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.


Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of IoT architectures, including connectivity options (e.G., NB-IoT, LTE-M), device management, and cloud platforms.


Voice of the Customer & Innovation: Catalyst Act as an internal champion for customer needs. Translate feedback into actionable insights to influence product innovation and roadmap direction.


Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customers, the sales team, and internal stakeholders to support customers, leveraging both Acceleronix and third-party offerings.


Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.

Customer-Centric Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.


Location Based in Brazil, Campinas.


Schedule: This position requires flexibility to work in shifts and be on-call, including weekends and holidays, to support customers across different time zones. Availability for emergency escalations and regional coordination is essential. Candidates must be prepared to adjust working hours as needed to ensure consistent service coverage and issue resolution.


Travel: The role requires frequent travel, approximately 25% of the time, both within Brazil and internationally, including multi-week business trips as needed.


This is a role at the forefront of a fast-growing tech sector, offering high-impact exposure to IoT innovation, digital transformation, and global ecosystems. You’ll join a collaborative and innovative environment within a dynamic international team, with ample opportunities for professional growth, leadership, and advancement. In addition to shaping and scaling global customer success operations, you'll benefit from competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.


Join us at Acceleronix and be a part of shaping the future of IoT.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Tecnológico Pleno (Projetista Mecânico) - 400225
description:
Para atuar no Grupo de Modelagem e Arquitetura de Sistemas Experimentais (MARE) do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O MARÉ integra a Divisão de Engenharia de Linhas de Luz (DEL) do Sirius, e tem como escopo principal projetar sistemas de instrumentação científica de alto desempenho e/ou complexidade, demandando visão sistêmica, modelagem preditiva e princípios de engenharia de precisão. Os projetos desenvolvidos podem incluir demandas como, nanoposicionamento, otimização de gestão térmica, óptica, vácuo, criogenia, altas temperaturas, pressões e campos magnéticos, bem como tópicos avançados de automação e controle, como os relacionados à sistemas de biocontenção e descontaminação.

Trata-se de um grupo altamente multidisciplinar, que conta com técnicos, especialistas, engenheiros e analistas de formações diversas, integrando ferramentas de engenharia de sistemas, modelagem multifísica, desenhos 3D, e modelos matemáticos para oferecer serviços de engenharia aplicados ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos de sistemas experimentais para linhas de luz dos laboratórios Sirius e Orion.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaboração de desenhos conceituais / técnicos, propostas de layouts e projetos de equipamentos de instrumentação científica / estações experimentais para as Linhas de Luz Orion/Sirius em software de modelagem 3D/2D, aplicando GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) quando necessário;
  • Gerar e gerenciar listas de materiais (BOM - Bill of Materials) e documentação técnica (Elaboração e atualização de documentação durante e após o desenvolvimento do projeto, incluindo manuais de montagem e operação, bem como esquemas pneumáticos e hidráulicos);
  • Liberação de desenhos para usinagem e acompanhamento da produção;
  • Prestar suporte técnico à fabricação, montagem e validação dos projetos desenvolvidos;
  • Garantir que todas as alterações e não conformidades sejam incorporadas e documentadas nos desenhos técnicos;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes internos e externos, fornecedores e áreas internas (Engenharia, Compras, Produção).

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Superior Completa em Tecnólogo em Mecânica, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em projetos de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Experiência com processos de fabricação (usinagem, soldagem, corte a laser/plasma, eletroerosão, tratamentos térmicos e superficiais);
  • Proficiência nos softwares Autodesk Inventor/SolidWorks (modelagem 3D/2D, chapas metálicas, estruturas soldadas, grandes montagens);
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em Revit, Tandem ou AutoCAD, incluindo elaboração de plantas baixas integradas a modelos 3D e integração de projetos entre diferentes plataformas;
  • Experiência em simulação por Método dos Elementos Finitos (FEM) utilizando Ansys ou outros softwares;
  • Experiência com sistemas criogênicos e/ou de altas pressões e temperaturas;
  • Experiência em metrologia, calibração, montagem e testes;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos para desenvolvimento de projetos.

Reafirmamos nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, incentivando a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, neurodivergentes, mulheres, LGBTI+, de diversas etnias, gerações e corpos, além de outros grupos socialmente marginalizados.

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

description:
Sobre nós

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores -
Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta
- a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.

Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn.

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Etapas do Processo

  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.
  • Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios:

Saúde e Bem-estar

Vida Financeira

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível
O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.

Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

title: Técnico (a) de Enfermagem - UTI Adulto / Hospital Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

title: Senior Onboarding and Compliance Processes
description:
ABOUT US:

Hedgepoint operates across five continents, connecting local and global markets, helping to protect against price volatility in a world in transition. Offering over 450 hedging products across 50+ commodities and currencies (FX), we also provide market intelligence and specialized insights to help clients turn risk into opportunities. We value transparency and respect in all our relationships, whether with clients or employees, ensuring a unique experience in every interaction. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing everyone for their uniqueness, without any form of discrimination.

Read more:

Join our team and help us to turn risks into opportunities

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

Analyst will optimize client and partner onboarding by designing, maintaining, and enhancing workflows and digital solutions. Leveraging data analysis and business intelligence tools, this role will streamline registration processes while ensuring strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

CORE COMPETENCES:

  • Onboarding Systems:
    Proficiency in onboarding software and digital KYC/KYP solutions to design system requirements, including checklists, forms, flows, etc.) and perform tests for implementation.
  • Regulatory:
    Knowledge of financial regulations and clients documents verifications.
  • Process Optimization:
    Skilled in business process mapping (BPMN) and redesign.
  • Risk and Control:
    Design internal controls for risk mitigation, including policies and procedures for Onboarding.
  • Project:
    End-to-end project management capabilities.
  • Data:
    Design and implement dashboards, detailed reports, and database integrity for recordkeeping.
  • Financial Sector Expertise:
    Understanding of financial services operations.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design and execute end-to-end onboarding processes for clients and sales partners within financial services, ensuring compliance with global AML, Suitability, KYC, and KYP regulations, as well as internal policies. Support process optimization through requirements gathering, BPMN process mapping, data analysis, and testing and implementation of digital solutions. Produce and maintain client checklists, forms, and customer FAQ documentation. Assess operational risks, establish appropriate controls, develop and maintain relevant policies and procedures, assist the onboarding team, and facilitate effective communication among Compliance, Credit, Legal, IT, and Sales departments for onboarding solutions. Design, test, and deploy compliant and efficient workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

ACTIVITIES DETAILS:

  • Analyze applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies
    , converting them into clear checklists, forms, and operational procedures.
  • Develop and continuously optimize onboarding workflows
    , including creating flow diagrams and checklists for required documentation.
  • Develop, revise, and maintain internal policies, standard operating procedures, manuals, and support materials
    , including FAQs for clients and partners.
  • Integrate regulatory requirements and internal guidelines
    into onboarding processes (Know Your Client – KYC and partner - KYP).
  • Review and understand individuals and corporate documents, to design onboarding verifications and analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client Services, Compliance, Legal, and Credit teams
    to gather necessary documentation and information for electronic KYC and KYP records.
  • Identify, assess, and support the onboarding processes
    ensuring adherence to internal and external regulations.
  • Design and implement analytical models, interactive dashboards, and detailed reports
    to support strategic and operational decisions.
  • Configure and maintain onboarding systems
    , ensuring accurate technical setup.
  • Draft technical requirements and perform testing
    of technology solutions implemented in onboarding-related systems.
  • Liaise with key platform partners
    to align onboarding processes, mitigating risks and delays.
  • Create training materials and conduct training sessions
    for internal teams.
  • Ensure integrity, maintenance, and regular updates of client and partner databases
    , performing audits to ensure data accuracy.
  • Stablish controls for documentation and clients' information
    in accordance with internal policies and regulatory standards.
  • Continuously monitor onboarding performance
    , identify gaps, propose data-driven solutions, and develop structured action plans.
  • Register client information into internal systems
    , monitor account opening requests, and proactively communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Control and periodically review internal registrations and records
    , ensuring they are accurate and up to date

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree (B.S.) or higher
    in Information Technology, Automation Engineering, Law, Data Engineering, Regulatory Compliance, or related fields from top-tier universities.
  • Experience in financial markets.
  • Experience with CRM systems and databases (e.g., SQL, Salesforce).
  • Proficiency in data analysis.
  • Ability to create system requirements and conduct user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel; VBA is a plus).
  • Knowledge of BPMN and flowchart tools (e.g., Bizagi).
  • Familiarity with Python and AI applications for data analysis.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

LOCATION:

Campinas, SP - Up to twice a week at the base office in Cambui, Campinas - SP. (Hybrid)

Como um importante player global em levedura e fermentação, a Lesaffre projeta, fabrica e comercializa soluções inovadoras para panificação, sabor e prazer de alimentos, saúde e biotecnologia.
Grupo familiar nascido no norte da França em 1853, hoje Lesaffre é uma empresa multinacional e multicultural comprometida em trabalhar com confiança para melhor nutrir e proteger o planeta.
Em estreita colaboração com seus clientes e parceiros, a Lesaffre emprega pessoas em cerca de 80 subsidiárias localizadas em mais de 50 países.
A Lesaffre atinge um volume de negócios de 2.200 milhões de euros.

  • Capacidade de fornecer suporte e recomendações completos à produção dos clientes

  • Sugerir novas aplicações e produtos

Além disso:

  • Ser a referência da Lesaffre para os clientes em aplicações e processos de panificação
  • Realizar demonstração de produtos em clientes reforçando as características técnicas do produto e a proposta de valor
  • Preparação de materiais técnicos para seminários e eventos e geração de conteúdo técnico
  • Promover treinamentos e workshops com clientes industriais, através de treinamentos práticos e teóricos in loco ou eventos
